tasks.memory_basis: Eight independent current V numerical/map/public/extended/composition/latency/264bit add-RNE and130bit exact normalization proofs. Actual423 final setup failure motivates replay-fetch register before exactS33 subtract/clamp with explicit odd-tail mask and aligned metadata; new latency contract asserted independently. One c96 six disjoint16CPU tasks, immediate refill; map64GiB, others16GiB,1.2 forecast margin plus16GiB guard/liveRSS. No input-domain reduction, no accepted M/S/T repeat, no cancellation. New measurements and every fresh physical gate remain required.
